from policies import Ranking, smaller, larger

def winner(data: Ranking) -> int:
    a, b = data["first_id"], data["next_id"]
    match data["mode"]:
        case "oldest": return smaller(a, b)
        case "newest": return larger(a, b)
    raise ValueError("unknown mode")

python.panel.py:
from policies import Rounding, even_units, upper_units

def round_tenths(value: int, policy: Rounding) -> int:
    if value < 0: raise ValueError("negative")
    whole, rest = divmod(value, 10)
    if rest < 5: return whole
    if rest > 5: return whole + 1
    match policy:
        case "upper_half": return upper_units(whole)
        case "even_half": return even_units(whole)
    raise ValueError("unknown policy")
